decisions.statement: A flag this page does not name is refused though the module beneath takes it.
The seat resumed is named by the first word.
A seat to resume is named as that seat's page is named.
The code a resume runs is reached only once a resume is read.
The output a resume prints is written where the resume runs.
A resume refused after it revived the seat names each write it finished.
A name no seat holds brings that seat's page back from history and resumes it.
A resume refused before it wrote anything is refused as the fault alone.
A notice named by slug is composed here into the first turn the seat takes up.
A notice slug no page carries is refused as the caller's fault.

definition: the command putting a seat back on the session that seat was bound to
